control_point: Periodic portfolio reconciliation with counterparties is performed and valuation or term differences are resolved under the applicable derivatives risk-mitigation framework.

citations.source_name: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 149/2013 (EMIR RTS on clearing and risk mitigation), Article 13 - portfolio reconciliation

consequence_anchor.public_source: Uncleared derivatives margin and valuation-dispute frameworks under EMIR risk-mitigation RTS and CFTC margin rules; failure to reconcile exposes counterparties to stale margin calls and settlement disputes
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: operational cost of dispute resolution and potential margin shortfall; supervisory penalties in the low- to mid-million-euro/dollar range for persistent failures to maintain risk-mitigation arrangements

commonality_rationale: All in-scope OTC derivatives counterparties must periodically reconcile open portfolios with each other; mismatches in valuation or terms are a recurring source of margin disputes and are explicitly regulated in both EU and US regimes.
